```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

setwd("~/Thesis")

#-------------------------------
#reading and cleaning the dataset
header_line <- readLines("ESS6e02_6.csv", n = 1)
column_names <- unlist(strsplit(header_line, ","))  

ess6 <- read.csv("ESS6e02_6.csv", sep = ",", header = FALSE,skip = 1,
                 col.names = column_names, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

colnames(ess6) <- gsub("^X\\.", "", colnames(ess6))     
colnames(ess6) <- gsub("\\.$", "", colnames(ess6))      

#-------------------------------

#-------------------------------
#basic overview of the dataset


cat("Dataset Dimensions (Rows x Columns):\n")
dim(ess6) # data dimension


cat("\n Structure of the Data:\n")
str(ess6[1:10]) #structure of data

# no of missing values
cat("\n Missing Values (Top 20 variables):\n")
na_summary <- sapply(ess6, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))
sort(na_summary, decreasing = TRUE)[1:20] 

key_vars <- c("cntry", "gndr", "agea", "physact", "stflife", "happy", "hinctnta")
available_vars <- key_vars[key_vars %in% colnames(ess6)]




#Respondent Count by Country
if ("cntry" %in% colnames(ess6)) {
  cat("\n Respondents per Country:\n")
    ess6 %>%
      group_by(cntry) %>%
      summarise(count = n()) %>%
      arrange(desc(count))
}

#Gender Distribution: 1-Male, 2-Female, 9-No answer
if ("gndr" %in% colnames(ess6)) {
  cat("\nGender Distribution:\n")
  table(ess6$gndr, useNA = "ifany")
}

#-------------------------------

#-------------------------------
#basic plotting of the datasets
```

```{r}

# dropping the NA for plots
ess6_plot <- ess6 %>% filter(!is.na(cntry), !is.na(gndr), !is.na(agea), !is.na(physact), !is.na(happy), !is.na(hinctnta))


#Country distribution (top 20 countries )
ess6 %>%
  count(cntry, sort = TRUE) %>%
  top_n(20) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(cntry, n), y = n)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top 15 Countries by Respondent Count", x = "Country", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#Gender distribution

ess6$gender_label <- factor(ess6$gndr,
                            levels = c(1, 2, 9),
                            labels = c("Male", "Female", "No Answer"))
ggplot(ess6, aes(x = as.factor(gender_label))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "orange") +
  labs(title = "Gender Distribution", x = "Gender", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#physical activity frequency

ggplot(ess6, aes(x = as.factor(physact))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "darkred") +
  labs(title = "Physical Activity Frequency", x = "Physical Activity Code", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
#Age distribution

ess6$agea <- ifelse(ess6$agea == 999, NA, ess6$agea)

ggplot(ess6, aes(x = agea)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Age Distribution of Respondents",
       x = "Age",
       y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
#happiness distribution
ess6$happy <- ifelse(ess6$happy %in% c(77, 88, 99), NA, ess6$happy)


ggplot(ess6 %>% filter(!is.na(happy)), aes(x = as.factor(happy))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "goldenrod", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Happiness Levels",
       x = "Happiness (0 = extremely unhappy, 10 = extremely happy)",
       y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
#  Income decile distribution
ess6$hinctnta_clean <- ifelse(ess6$hinctnta %in% c(77, 88, 99), NA, ess6$hinctnta)

ess6$income_decile_label <- factor(ess6$hinctnta_clean, levels = 1:10,
                                   labels = paste("Decile", 1:10))

ggplot(ess6, aes(x = as.factor(income_decile_label))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "dodgerblue") +
  labs(title = "Income Decile Distribution", x = "Income Decile", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

#-------------------------------
```

```{r}
#-------------------------------

#Exploring relationships between physical activity and gender

ess6$physact <- ifelse(ess6$physact %in% c(77, 88, 99), NA, ess6$physact)

# Bar plot: Activity frequency by gender
ggplot(ess6 %>% filter(!is.na(physact), gndr %in% c(1, 2)), 
       aes(x = factor(physact), fill = gender_label)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Physical Activity by Gender",
       x = "Physically Active for the last 7 days",
       y = "Count",
       fill = "Gender") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
#-------------------------------

#Exploring relationships between physical activity and age

ess6$age_group <- cut(ess6$agea,
                      breaks = c(14, 29, 44, 59, 74, 100),
                      labels = c("15–29", "30–44", "45–59", "60–74", "75+"),
                      right = TRUE)

ggplot(ess6 %>% filter(!is.na(age_group), !is.na(physact)), 
       aes(x = as.factor(physact), fill = age_group)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Physical Activity by Age Group",
       x = "Physically Active Days (last 7 days)",
       y = "Count",
       fill = "Age Group") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
#-------------------------------

#Exploring relationships between physical activity and country
ess6 %>%
  filter(!is.na(physact), !is.na(cntry)) %>%
  group_by(cntry) %>%
  summarise(avg_physact = mean(physact, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(cntry, avg_physact), y = avg_physact)) +
  geom_col(fill = "seagreen") +
  labs(title = "Average Physical Activity by Country",
       x = "Country", y = "Average Activity Level (0–7)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
```{r}
#-------------------------------

#Exploring relationships between physical activity and happiness
ess6 %>%
  filter(!is.na(happy), !is.na(physact)) %>%
  group_by(physact) %>%
  summarise(avg_happy = mean(happy, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = physact, y = avg_happy)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue", size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(title = "Average Happiness by Physical Activity Level",
       x = "Physical Activity (Days per Week)", y = "Average Happiness") +
  theme_minimal()


```

```{r}

#-------------------------------

#Exploring relationships between physical activity and income level
ess6$hinctnta <- ifelse(ess6$hinctnta %in% c(77, 88, 99), NA, ess6$hinctnta)


ess6 %>%
  filter(!is.na(physact), !is.na(hinctnta)) %>%
  group_by(hinctnta) %>%
  summarise(avg_physact = mean(physact, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = hinctnta, y = avg_physact)) +
  geom_line(color = "darkgreen", size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(title = "Average Physical Activity by Income Level",
       x = "Income Level (1 = Lowest, 10 = Highest)",
       y = "Average Physical Activity (Days per Week)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
